name: Maximilian Weber
bio: Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Nürburgring. He quickly gravitated towards the strategic side of racing, fascinated by the complex decisions that can make or break a team's chances. He pursued a degree in engineering, specializing in data analysis, before landing a role at Toyota Gazoo Racing BR. Maximilian believes a strategist must be able to quickly adapt to changing conditions, using data and intuition to make informed decisions under pressure. He is known for his calm demeanor and ability to identify opportunities that others might miss, often suggesting unconventional but effective strategies.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part
physical.description: Maximilian is a man of average height with a thoughtful expression, always seeming to be deep in thought.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in concentration.
Insists on having a specific type of German mineral water on hand during races.
